title: memory.process_list
description: Extract process list from memory dump using Volatility3. Returns structured array of processes with creation/exit times and suspicion flags.

case_id.description: UUID v4 case identifier from case.open.

kdbg_offset.description: Optional hex offset (0x...) of KDBG structure for manual memory analysis. If omitted, Volatility3 auto-detects.

inputSchema.description: Case identifier required; KDBG offset optional for advanced debugging.

name.description: Process name or executable basename (max 64 chars).

exit_time.description: ISO 8601 process exit timestamp (null if still running at dump time).

suspicious_flags.description: Array of suspicion markers. Empty if process appears normal.

processes.description: Array of processes extracted from memory image.

mem_image_path.description: Absolute path to memory dump analyzed.

tool_used.description: Tool that generated the process list.

outputSchema.description: Process list with timestamps, parent relationships, and suspicion flags.

x-mcp-capability.name: memory.process_list
x-mcp-capability.description: Extract and enumerate processes from memory dump (Volatility3).
constraints: case_id must be valid UUID v4 from case.open
Process timestamps must be ISO 8601 format
exit_time must be null for running processes (dump-time snapshot)
suspicious_flags array must use only whitelisted enum values
